flags.message: CourtListener MCP was rate-limited (HTTP 429, 300/hour bucket, ~14 minutes to reset) on this cell's first call, so no live CourtListener data informed this prediction; it rests on the provisioned snapshot, the petition text, the statpack and two corpus queries.
